title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
summary:
Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026, delivering next-generation intelligence for agentic workflows and cybersecurity. These models build on the same foundational intelligence, accelerated by agentic loops and rigorous cybersecurity training.

Gemini 3.8 Flash is described as Google's most intelligent workhorse model, offering significant improvements over 3.7 Flash in software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning, often approaching the performance of higher-cost frontier models. It "works harder" by executing more reasoning steps and tool calls. This model is available to developers via the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, and Android Studio; to enterprises through Gemini Enterprise; and to consumers with Google AI Pro and Ultra subscriptions. It maintains the same introductory price as 3.7 Flash.

Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is Google's most capable cybersecurity model, demonstrating frontier-level performance in autonomous vulnerability discovery (e.g., CyberGym) and automated patching (e.g., CWE-Bench). It focuses on defensive capabilities and has already shown real-world impact in securing Google's code, including Chrome and Cloud vulnerabilities. Due to its more permissive cybersecurity mitigations, Flash Cyber is exclusively available to trusted defenders, such as government authorities and critical infrastructure operators, through the new Fairwind Program.

Both models are built with safety in mind, incorporating safeguards against misuse in CBRN and cyber offense domains, and feature significant improvements in prompt injection robustness.
chinese_title: 双子座 3.8 闪 和 3.8 闪 赛博
chinese_summary:
谷歌于2026年9月2日推出了Gemini 3.8 Flash和3.8 Flash Cyber，为代理工作流和网络安全提供下一代智能。这些模型建立在相同的基本智能之上，并通过代理循环和严格的网络安全训练得到加速。

Gemini 3.8 Flash被描述为谷歌最智能的“主力模型”，在软件工程、代理任务和多步推理方面相比3.7 Flash有显著改进，性能常接近更高成本的前沿模型。它通过执行更多推理步骤和工具调用来“更努力地工作”。该模型通过Gemini API、Google AI Studio和Android Studio向开发者开放；通过Gemini Enterprise向企业提供；并通过Google AI Pro和Ultra订阅向消费者提供。它保持与3.7 Flash相同的入门价格。

Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber是谷歌最强大的网络安全模型，在自主漏洞发现（例如CyberGym）和自动化补丁修复（例如CWE-Bench）方面展现出前沿水平的性能。它专注于防御能力，并已在保护谷歌代码安全方面展现出实际影响，包括Chrome和云服务的漏洞。由于其更灵活的网络安全缓解措施，Flash Cyber仅通过新的“顺风计划”向可信赖的防御者（例如政府机构和关键基础设施运营商）提供。

这两个模型在设计时都考虑了安全性，融入了防范在核生化（CBRN）和网络攻击领域滥用的安全措施，并在提示注入的鲁棒性方面有显著改进。

title: .name Termination
summary:
Neil Fraser reports the imminent termination of all 3rd-level .name domains, including his long-standing neil.fraser.name, established nearly 25 years ago as his website, email, and API server. Verisign proposed this action on April 15, 2026, to simplify administration, and ICANN approved it on July 28, 2026, despite Fraser's domain being paid until 2040. The termination takes effect in February 2027.

Fraser, one of 22,000 affected users, emphasizes that .name 3rd-level domains are legitimate, with full WHOIS records, unlike other dubious 3rd-level offerings. He initially chose .name due to his distrust of Verisign, which later acquired Global Name Registry, validating his concerns through what he calls Verisign's "numerous lies" in their proposal.

The termination means Fraser's website and email will vanish, and his IoT devices linked to the domain will cease functioning. A more critical threat is the potential for someone else to register the now-vacant 2nd-level domain (fraser.name). This would allow them to recreate neil.fraser.name, potentially hijacking hundreds of linked accounts, committing code under his authentication, and seizing control of his IoT devices. Fraser concludes by stating he will "lawyer up."
chinese_title: .name 终止
chinese_summary:
Neil Fraser报告称，包括他近25年前作为网站、电子邮件和API服务器设立并长期使用的neil.fraser.name在内的所有三级.name域名即将被终止。Verisign于2026年4月15日提出此举，旨在简化管理，ICANN于2026年7月28日批准，尽管Fraser的域名已付费至2040年。该终止将于2027年2月生效。

作为22,000名受影响用户之一，Fraser强调，.name三级域名是合法的，拥有完整的WHOIS记录，这与其他可疑的三级域名服务不同。他最初选择.name域名是因为不信任Verisign，而Verisign后来收购了Global Name Registry，并通过其提案中他所称的Verisign的“大量谎言”证实了他的担忧。

此次终止意味着Fraser的网站和电子邮件将消失，与其域名关联的物联网设备也将停止运作。一个更严重的威胁是，其他人可能会注册现在空置的二级域名（fraser.name）。这将使他们能够重新创建neil.fraser.name，从而可能劫持数百个关联账户，以他的身份提交代码，并夺取对他物联网设备的控制权。Fraser最后表示他将“寻求法律帮助”。

title: Audacity 4.0
summary:
Audacity 4.0 marks a major rebuild of the audio editor, introducing a completely revamped interface on Qt with native high-DPI rendering and extensive customization. Users can save UI layouts as Workspaces (Modern, Classic, Music), choose from various themes, and dock/float toolbars. A new Home screen shows recent projects with preview thumbnails.

A significant focus is on the new clip-editing model, allowing direct selection and editing of multiple clips, grouping, and flexible placement across tracks. A dedicated splitting tool and improved paste functionality streamline workflows. Previous separate tool modes (Select, Envelope, Draw, Multi-tool) are now context-sensitive.

Playback and recording see enhancements like a persistent, draggable playhead, seeking without stopping, and recording starting at any timeline position. Official Windows builds now support ASIO. Track headers include live meters, and built-in effects are rebuilt for the new interface, supporting VST3, Nyquist, LV2, and Audio Units. The Spectrogram has been redesigned for clarity.

Projects now use the `.aup4` format, converting `.aup3` projects while leaving originals untouched (though not savable back to `.aup3`). Older `.aup` projects can also be imported. The Audacity logo has been updated.

Key features currently missing from Audacity 3 include Time Tracks, Note/MIDI tracks, Mixer, Macro Manager/scripting pipe, VAMP/LADSPA plugin hosting, and Play-at-speed, with plans for future reintroduction. Some exporting, rendering, analyzers, and effects are also temporarily absent.
chinese_title: Audacity 4.0
chinese_summary:
Audacity 4.0 标志着这款音频编辑器的一次重大重建，引入了一个基于 Qt 全面革新的界面，具有原生的DPI渲染和广泛的自定义功能。用户可以将 UI 布局保存为工作区（现代、经典、音乐），从多种主题中选择，并可停靠/浮动工具栏。新的“主页”屏幕显示带有预览缩略图的近期项目。

一个重要的关注点是新的片段编辑模型，允许直接选择和编辑多个片段、进行分组，并灵活地在不同轨道上放置。专用的分割工具和改进的粘贴功能简化了工作流程。以前独立的工具模式（选择、包络、绘图、多工具）现在变为上下文敏感。

播放和录制方面也有增强，例如持久、可拖动的播放头、无需停止即可查找以及可在时间轴上任何位置开始录制。官方 Windows 版本现在支持 ASIO。轨道头部包含实时电平表，内置效果已针对新界面进行重建，支持 VST3、Nyquist、LV2 和 Audio Units。频谱图也经过重新设计，以提高清晰度。

项目现在使用 .aup4 格式，转换 .aup3 项目时，原始文件保持不变（尽管无法保存回 .aup3 格式）。更旧的 .aup 项目也可以导入。Audacity 标志已更新。

Audacity 3 中目前缺失的关键功能包括时间轨道、音符/MIDI 轨道、混音器、宏管理器/脚本管道、VAMP/LADSPA 插件宿主和变速播放，但计划在未来重新引入。部分导出、渲染、分析器和效果也暂时缺失。

title: GPT-6 Astra
summary:
GPT-6 Astra is introduced as OpenAI's next-generation, most intelligent, and aligned model, setting new benchmarks across multiple domains. It achieves state-of-the-art performance, including 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4, 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3, and a perfect 100% on ExploitBench.

Astra significantly advances computer use, completing tasks 47% faster than GPT-5.6 Sol on OSWorld 2.0 and 1.9x faster on Mind2Web. It excels at automating tedious tasks, online research, data analysis, and web development. For professional work, it produces polished documents, adheres to templates, and interprets instructions effectively. In software engineering, Astra is the best model to date, with state-of-the-art coding and an innovative Codex feature for preserving context. It also represents a major advance for scientific discovery.

In cybersecurity, Astra reaches a "Critical" capability threshold, demonstrating proficiency in identifying and developing zero-day exploits, even discovering new ones during evaluation. While initially focused on defensive applications like secure code review, broader access for vulnerability analysis and malware analysis is planned.

Crucially, Astra is OpenAI's most aligned model, showing substantial improvements in understanding user intent, respecting task boundaries (0% deviation in critical tests), and transparent communication. It will be rolled out to limited organizations, then to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise users, and via the OpenAI API and AWS.
chinese_title: GPT-6 阿斯特拉
chinese_summary:
GPT-6 Astra 被推出为 OpenAI 的下一代、最智能、最对齐的模型，在多个领域树立了新基准。它取得了最先进的性能，包括在 FrontierMath Tier 4 上达到 98%，在 ARC-AGI-3 上达到 99.9%，并在 ExploitBench 上达到完美的 100%。

Astra 显著提升了计算机使用效率，在 OSWorld 2.0 上完成任务的速度比 GPT-5.6 Sol 快 47%，在 Mind2Web 上快 1.9 倍。它擅长自动化繁琐任务、在线研究、数据分析和网络开发。在专业工作中，它能生成精美的文档，遵循模板，并有效解读指令。在软件工程领域，Astra 是迄今为止最好的模型，具备最先进的编码能力和创新的 Codex 功能以保留上下文。它也代表了科学发现方面的一大进步。

在网络安全领域，Astra 达到了“关键”能力阈值，展示了识别和开发零日漏洞的熟练度，甚至在评估期间发现了新的漏洞。虽然最初专注于安全代码审查等防御性应用，但计划在漏洞分析和恶意软件分析方面提供更广泛的访问。

至关重要的是，Astra 是 OpenAI 最对齐的模型，在理解用户意图、遵守任务边界（在关键测试中偏差为 0%）和透明沟通方面表现出显著改进。它将首先向有限的组织推出，随后面向 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 用户，并通过 OpenAI API 和 AWS 提供。

title: A note on subscription prices from LWN
summary:
LWN has announced an upcoming increase in subscription prices, effective September 15th, attributing the decision to significant changes in the global economy and rising costs. This comes after consumer-price inflation has reached nearly 20% since their last price adjustment in early 2022, with some expenses like health insurance increasing even more.

The publication, which adopted its reader-supported subscription model in 2002 to maintain independence from advertising, highlights that reader support is crucial for its existence. LWN has rarely increased prices (only twice in 24 years). The previous increase allowed them to expand coverage by hiring new staff (Daroc Alden and Joe Brockmeier), enhance site features (e.g., EPUB articles, markdown comments, dark mode, kernel database), and strengthen defenses against scraper attacks.

The new prices, reflecting an approximate 20% increase to match inflation, will be: Starving hacker ($6.00), Professional hacker ($11.00), Project leader ($19.00), and Maniacal supporter ($55.00). Group subscriptions will also see a proportional rise.

Existing pre-purchased subscriptions will remain valid until their original expiration. Monthly subscribers active before the announcement will continue paying the old rate for the next six months, with reminders sent before the new rates apply.

While LWN prefers keeping prices low and increasing volume, stalled subscriber growth necessitates this short-term measure as they develop long-term growth strategies. Approaching its 30th year, LWN expresses deep gratitude to its loyal readers, crediting their support as the reason for its sustained vitality.
chinese_title: LWN 订阅价格说明
chinese_summary:
LWN宣布将于9月15日起上调订阅价格，将此决定归因于全球经济的重大变化和成本的上涨。自2022年初上次价格调整以来，消费价格通胀已接近20%，而医疗保险等一些费用甚至增长更多。

该出版物于2002年采纳了读者支持的订阅模式，以保持其独立性，不受广告影响，并强调读者的支持对其生存至关重要。LWN 很少涨价（24年内仅两次）。上次涨价使他们得以通过聘用新员工（Daroc Alden和Joe Brockmeier）来扩大内容覆盖范围，增强网站功能（例如EPUB文章、Markdown评论、深色模式、内核数据库），并加强了对爬虫攻击的防御。

新价格将上涨约20%以匹配通胀，具体为：Starving hacker（6.00美元）、Professional hacker（11.00美元）、Project leader（19.00美元）和Maniacal supporter（55.00美元）。团体订阅价格也将按比例上涨。

现有的预购订阅将继续有效，直至其原始到期日。在公告发布前活跃的月度订阅者将在未来六个月内继续支付旧价格，在新价格生效前会收到提醒。

尽管LWN倾向于保持低价并扩大订阅量，但订阅用户增长停滞迫使他们采取这一短期措施，同时他们也在制定长期增长战略。随着LWN即将迎来成立30周年，它向忠实读者表达了深切的感谢，并将持续的活力归功于他们的支持。

title: Muse Spark 1.3
summary:
Muse Spark is presented as Meta's most compact and efficient generative AI model, specifically designed for on-device applications and edge deployment. It is part of Meta's family of AI models, optimized for scenarios where low latency, small model size, and local processing are crucial.

Key features include its high efficiency and ability to run directly on devices, making it suitable for a wide range of mobile, wearable, and IoT applications. This enables real-time AI capabilities without relying on cloud connectivity, enhancing user privacy and reducing operational costs. Muse Spark is positioned for use cases such as on-device content creation, personalized AI experiences, and intelligent voice assistants.

Developers can access Muse Spark through Meta's AI models program, with resources available to integrate it into their applications. The model emphasizes enabling developers to build innovative, privacy-preserving, and performant AI features directly into their products.
chinese_title: 缪斯火花 1.3
chinese_summary:
Muse Spark 被视为 Meta 最紧凑、最高效的生成式AI模型，专为设备端应用和边缘部署而设计。它是Meta AI模型家族的一部分，针对低延迟、小模型尺寸和本地处理至关重要的场景进行了优化。

其主要特点包括高效率和直接在设备上运行的能力，使其适用于广泛的移动、可穿戴设备和物联网应用。这使得无需依赖云连接即可实现实时AI功能，从而增强用户隐私并降低运营成本。Muse Spark 定位用于设备端内容创作、个性化AI体验和智能语音助手等用例。

开发者可以通过Meta的AI模型计划访问Muse Spark，并可获得相关资源将其集成到他们的应用程序中。该模型强调使开发者能够将创新、保护隐私且高性能的AI功能直接构建到他们的产品中。

title: Three sites made 215,128 “best software” pages for AI. Perplexity cites them
summary:
A study examined the sources Perplexity AI models (sonar and sonar-pro) use to answer "best software" questions across 380 categories, analyzing 7,534 citations. A striking discovery was that 59.8% of citations pointed to domains ranked worse than #100,000 in Tranco, and 23.4% were entirely outside the top million. These low-ranked domains were also notably newer, with a median first Wayback capture of 2020 compared to 2011 for ranked domains.

Key problematic sources included guideflow.com, a vendor's marketing blog, which was the third most-cited domain despite not being a review site and not competing in the cited categories. More concerningly, three sites—wifitalents.com, worldmetrics.org, and gitnux.org—registered recently (Dec 2023-May 2024) and sharing infrastructure, collectively published 215,128 machine-generated "best <category> software" pages. Their homepages were titled "Facts & Grounding Page," suggesting they are optimized for AI retrieval rather than human readers. These sites also offered inconsistent "best" rankings for the same category.

Additionally, some recommended vendor homepages were unreachable or redirected to unrelated sites, like online gambling portals. The study clarifies it measured Perplexity's retrieval layer, not other AI models, and focused on the nature of the evidence base rather than the quality of the final recommendations. It highlights a significant reliance of AI models on new, low-quality, and machine-generated content for grounding information.
chinese_title: 三个网站制作了215,128个AI“最佳软件”页面。Perplexity引用了这些网站。
chinese_summary:
一项研究调查了Perplexity AI模型（sonar和sonar-pro）在回答380个类别中“最佳软件”问题时使用的来源，并分析了7,534条引文。一个惊人的发现是，59.8%的引文指向Tranco排名低于100,000的域名，而23.4%的引文则完全在排名前一百万之外。这些低排名域名也明显更新，其Wayback Machine首次捕获时间的中间值为2020年，而有排名的域名则为2011年。

主要的问题来源包括guideflow.com，这是一个供应商的营销博客，尽管它不是评论网站，也不在引用的类别中竞争，却是被引用次数第三多的域名。更令人担忧的是，有三个网站——wifitalents.com、worldmetrics.org和gitnux.org——近期（2023年12月至2024年5月）注册并共享基础设施，共同发布了215,128个机器生成的“最佳<类别>软件”页面。它们的首页标题为“事实与基础页面”，表明它们是为AI检索而非人类读者优化的。这些网站还为同一类别提供了不一致的“最佳”排名。

此外，一些被推荐的供应商主页无法访问，或被重定向到不相关的网站，例如在线赌博门户。该研究澄清，它衡量的是Perplexity的检索层，而非其他AI模型，并且侧重于证据基础的性质，而非最终推荐的质量。这凸显了AI模型在获取基础信息时，对新的、低质量和机器生成内容的严重依赖。
